articles.title: Bitcoin’s latest chart signal looks a lot like the ones before its big crashes
articles.snippet: The Guppy Multiple Moving Average bands signal a bearish momentum, even as seasonality and post-midterm history lean bullish.

articles.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

articles.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
articles.snippet: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.

articles.title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
articles.snippet: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.

articles.title: North Korea Denies $6.3B Binance Hack, Calls FBI Finding a 'Political Provocation'
articles.snippet: Kim Yo Jong suggested the U.S. itself could be behind the theft, as Binance said hourly deposits had begun to exceed withdrawals.
